in_marathi.name: Kumaran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Younger brother of God Murugan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kumaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kumaran is a name that holds significant importance in Hindu mythology. It is the name of the younger brother of Lord Murugan, also known as Kartikeya or Subramaniam. Kumaran is revered for his bravery and wisdom, making it an ideal name for a baby boy. In Hindu tradition, he is often depicted carrying a spear and vel, symbolizing strength and power.
